title: LinkedTxn

TxnId.description: Product: QBW Description: Transaction the current entity is related to (linked to), for example, Sales Order.[br /]UNSUPPORTED FIELD. Product: QBO Description: A list of Estimate Ids that are to be associated with the invoice.[br /]Note: Only Pending and Accepted Estimates can be specified. Closed and Rejected estimates will be ignored.

TxnLineId.description: Product: ALL Description: A link to a specific line of the LinkedTxn. If supplied the LinkedTxn field must also be populated.

description: That minimal subset of transaction information which is included on another transaction, so that a client viewing the second transaction entity need not make an additional request to the service in order to render it in human readable form. (e.g a payment needs to refer to an invoice by number)
